description: Separate from #768 membership retirement. Earlier cancellation investigation (zaq-emb.31.13) found remote RPC execution surviving caller death and local single-node work owned by a Jido.Exec timeout worker. No remote cancellation guarantee is established. Preserve and formalize a real multi-node reproducer before designing a fix; inspect NodeRouter RPC ownership and Action worker lifecycle rather than introducing channel-specific coordination. Scope is deferred evidence/ownership investigation, not implementation under the admission-time plan. No claim that graceful runtime retirement fixes generic RPC cancellation.
title: [follow-up] Remote Action execution can outlive its cancelled RPC caller
